Design a modern single-floor courtyard-shaped home on a 50 × 60 ft plot, with the road on the north. Include 3 bedrooms, 2 shared bathrooms, a living room, dining area, kitchen, utility room, a front sit-out, and parking for one car. Arrange the rooms around a central open-to-sky courtyard. Connect living and dining, and place the kitchen beside dining. Keep bedrooms in a quieter wing, accessible from a passage without walking through another bedroom. Provide windows facing the courtyard or outside. Keep parking separate from pedestrian circulation. No staircase is needed.
